title: Athena arms herself; the gates of heaven
intro: Athena arms herself. Hera drives through heaven's gates to ask Zeus for leave to intervene.

notes.text: δέω, bind / fasten: unaugmented 3sg aor. ζυγόν, yoke; λέπαδνον, breast-strap / harness strap: acc pl.
ἄγω, lead: 3sg 2aor; “led under the yoke.” ὠκύπους, swift-footed: acc pl.
μέμονα, be eager: perf act ptc nom fem sg + gen; ἔρις, strife; ἀϋτή, battle-cry / din.
πέπλος, robe; ἑανός, soft / fine, agrees with πέπλον here.
καταχέω, pour down / let fall: epic 3sg aor; οὖδας, floor: dat sg. She drops her robe on her father's floor.
ποικίλος, patterned / richly worked. κάμνω, work / fashion: unaugmented 3sg 2aor; “made with her own hands.”
ἐνδύω, put on: aor act ptc nom fem sg; χιτών, tunic: acc sg. Διὸς νεφεληγερέταο, “of cloud-gathering Zeus.”
θωρήσσομαι, arm oneself: unaugmented 3sg impf mid; τεῦχος, armour: dat pl.
δακρυόεις, tear-bringing: acc masc sg with πόλεμον, not with τεύχεσιν.
βάλλω, put on: unaugmented 3sg 2aor mid. αἰγίς, aegis: acc sg; θυσσανόεις, tasselled / fringed, acc fem sg.
στεφανόω, encircle / crown: 3sg perf mid/pass; “Fear is set all around it.” πάντῃ, on every side.
Strife; Battle-strength; chilling Pursuit. κρυόεις, chilling: nom fem sg; personifications on the aegis.
Γοργείη, Gorgon's; πέλωρον, monster: gen sg; σμερδνός, dreadful / terrifying. τέρας, portent / fearsome sign.
κάρα, head: dat sg κρατί; κυνέη, helmet: acc sg (originally a dogskin cap).
Helmet epithets: traditionally “double-crested … four-bossed.” Exact construction uncertain; φάλος refers to a helmet projection / crest-piece.
πρύλις, foot-soldier: dat pl; ἀραρίσκω, fit: perf act ptc acc fem sg with helmet. “Fitted for the warriors of a hundred cities,” divine-scale exaggeration.
ὄχεα, chariot; φλόγεος, flaming / shining. βαίνω, mount: unaugmented 3sg aor mid.
λάζομαι, take hold of: unaugmented 3sg impf mid.
βριθύς, heavy / weighty; στιβαρός, stout / massive; both with ἔγχος.
δάμνημι, subdue: 3sg pres act indicative (athematic -σι); στίξ, rank: acc pl.
κοτέω, be angry with: epic 3sg aor mid subj (-εται = -ηται), generalized relative clause + dat οἷσιν. ὀβριμοπάτρη, daughter of a mighty father, Athena.
μάστιξ, whip: dat sg; ἐπιμαίομαι, reach towards / ply: 3sg impf mid; Hera lashes the horses.
αὐτόματος, of one's own accord: nom fem pl with gates. μύκον, unaugmented 3pl 2aor of μυκάομαι, rumble / bellow.
Ὧραι, Seasons / Hours, heaven's gatekeepers. τῇς = αἷς, dat pl; ἐπιτρέπω, entrust: 3sg perf pass.
Both … and; two infinitives explain the gatekeepers' charge.
ἀνακλίνω, push back / open: aor act inf; ἐπιτίθημι, put on / close: aor act inf. πυκινόν, dense; the cloud serves as a gate.
τῇ, that way; αὐτάων gen fem pl, the gates. κεντρηνεκής, goaded / obedient to the goad: acc pl with horses.
ἄτερ + gen, apart from; ἧμαι, sit: pres mid ptc acc sg with Κρονίωνα, Zeus.
ἄκρος superlative, highest: dat fem sg with κορυφή, summit. πολυδειράς, many-ridged: gen sg with Olympus.
ἵστημι, halt: transitive aor ptc nom fem sg. Ζῆνα, epic acc of Zeus; ὕπατος, highest / supreme.
ἐξείρομαι, question / ask: 3sg impf mid.
